definitions.gloss: dashi-rolled omelette; Japanese omelette with dashi broth
definitions.explanation: A Japanese rolled omelette made by mixing beaten eggs with dashi broth, then rolling it in thin layers in a rectangular pan. Soft, moist, and savory.

examples.japanese: {出汁巻|だしま}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出汁巻|だしま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。

notes:
Short for {出汁巻|だしま}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧. A staple of Japanese home cooking and bento boxes. Distinguished from ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧ by the addition of ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (soup stock), which makes it softer and more moist. Particularly associated with Kansai-style cooking, where a lighter, more savory version is preferred over the sweeter Kanto-style ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出汁巻|だしま}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: dashi-rolled egg (full form)
- {出汁巻|だしま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to roll a dashi omelette
- ⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出汁巻|だしま}き: fluffy dashi omelette

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧: Japanese rolled omelette — the broader category; often sweeter, may not contain dashi
- ⟦{厚焼|あつや}き→厚焼き：27125_atsuyaki⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: thick omelette — a thicker, firmer style
- ⟦{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し→茶碗蒸し：17312_chawanmushi⟧: savory egg custard — also uses dashi but steamed, not rolled
